data in the Mapbox Terrain-RGB v1 tileset.

## Overview<a href="#overview" class="hash-link unprose color-blue-on-hover"
aria-label="Direct link to Overview"
title="Direct link to Overview">​</a>

**Mapbox Terrain-RGB** is a Mapbox-provided raster tileset contains
global elevation data encoded in raster PNG tiles as color values that
can be decoded to raw heights in meters.

You can use Terrain-RGB for a wide variety of applications, both visual
and analytical, from styling terrain slope and hillshades to generating
3D terrain meshes for video games.

<div class="mb18 border border--gray-lighter round-bold px18 py18">

class="hash-link unprose color-blue-on-hover"
aria-label="Direct link to Data sources and updates"
title="Direct link to Data sources and updates">​</a>

Elevation data is not improved on a set schedule and is updated when and
where it becomes available.

the Mapbox Terrain-RGB tileset. Data updates will be applied to the
[Mapbox Terrain-DEM](/data/tilesets/reference/mapbox-terrain-dem-v1/)
tileset, which is an optimized version of Mapbox Terrain-RGB.

### Attribution<a href="#attribution" class="hash-link unprose color-blue-on-hover"
aria-label="Direct link to Attribution"
title="Direct link to Attribution">​</a>

When using this tileset publicly in a design or application you must
provide <a href="https://docs.mapbox.com/help/dive-deeper/attribution/"
rel="noopener noreferrer">proper attribution</a>.

## Terrain-RGB tiles<a href="#terrain-rgb-tiles"
class="hash-link unprose color-blue-on-hover"
aria-label="Direct link to Terrain-RGB tiles"
title="Direct link to Terrain-RGB tiles">​</a>

The Mapbox Terrain-DEM tileset contains Terrain-RGB tiles.
**Terrain-RGB** tiles include elevation data that is encoded using each
color channel as a position in a base-256 numbering system. This
approach allows for 16,777,216 unique values which can be mapped to 0.1
meter height increments, enabling vertical precision necessary for
cartographic and 3D applications.

To learn how to retrieve a Terrain-RGB tile and decode elevation data
from its RGB values, see our [Access elevation
data](/data/tilesets/guides/access-elevation-data/) guide.

## Layer Reference<a href="#layer-reference" class="hash-link unprose color-blue-on-hover"
aria-label="Direct link to Layer Reference"
title="Direct link to Layer Reference">​</a>

This tileset contains one layer with raster data.

- **Data up to zoom 15**. The data is encoded to the equivalent of zoom
  15 at 256 tile resolution (and zoom 14 for 512 tiles). Any higher zoom
  levels will not increase the resolution of the data loaded by your
  application.
- **0.1 meter height increments**. Elevation data is mapped to 0.1 meter
  height increments, which gives it the vertical precision necessary for
  cartographic and 3D applications.

## Elevation data<a href="#elevation-data" class="hash-link unprose color-blue-on-hover"
aria-label="Direct link to Elevation data"
title="Direct link to Elevation data">​</a>

Mapbox Terrain-RGB uses multiple data sources depending on the zoom
level and location. Different sources often use different vertical datum
references, including but not limited to <a
href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_American_Vertical_Datum_of_1988"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><code>NAVD 88</code></a>,
<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earth_Gravitational_Model#EGM96"
target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><code>EGM 96</code></a>, and
<a
href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ordnance_datum#Ordnance_Datum_Newlyn_and_its_antecedents"
target="_blank"
rel="noopener noreferrer"><code>Ordnance Datum Newlyn</code></a>.

Different sources often use different vertical datum references; thus,
attempting to normalize Mapbox elevation data to a particular geoid or
vertical datum may lead to inaccuracies in data.

You can use <a href="https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/raster-tiles/"
rel="noopener noreferrer">this Raster Tiles API endpoint</a> with your
Mapbox <a href="https://docs.mapbox.com/help/glossary/access-token/"
rel="noopener noreferrer">access token</a> to get Terrain-RGB tiles:

<div class="language-text round-bold mb24 overflow-hidden relative"
as="div"
style="box-shadow:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 1px 2px 0px;background-color:#f6f8fa">

<div class="relative round-bold">

``` text
https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.terrain-rgb/{zoom}/{x}/{y}.pngraw?access_token=YOUR_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN
```

<div class="absolute z1 top right color-white flex"
style="margin-top:11px;margin-right:11px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 200ms ease-in-out">

<div role="button" aria-label="Copy" testid="copy-button"
clipboard-text="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.terrain-rgb/{zoom}/{x}/{y}.pngraw?access_token=YOUR_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN">

<span style="display:contents"></span>

<div type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"
state="closed">

<img
src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iZXZlbnRzLW5vbmUgaWNvbiIgZGF0YS10ZXN0aWQ9Imljb24tY2xpcGJvYXJkIiBzdHlsZT0id2lkdGg6MThweDtoZWlnaHQ6MThweCIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeG1sbnM6eGxpbms9Imh0dHA6Ly93d3cudzMub3JnLzE5OTkveGxpbmsiIHhsaW5rOmhyZWY9IiNpY29uLWNsaXBib2FyZCIgLz48L3N2Zz4="
class="events-none icon" /><span style="position:absolute;border:0;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0, 0, 0, 0);white-space:nowrap;word-wrap:normal">clipboard</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Then use this equation to decode pixel values to height values:

<div class="language-text round-bold mb24 overflow-hidden relative"
as="div"
style="box-shadow:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 1px 2px 0px;background-color:#f6f8fa">

<div class="relative round-bold">

``` text
height = -10000 + ((R * 256 * 256 + G * 256 + B) * 0.1)
```

<div class="absolute z1 top right color-white flex"
style="margin-top:11px;margin-right:11px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 200ms ease-in-out">

<div role="button" aria-label="Copy" testid="copy-button"
clipboard-text="height = -10000 + ((R * 256 * 256 + G * 256 + B) * 0.1)">

<span style="display:contents"></span>

<div type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"
state="closed">

<img
src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBjbGFzcz0iZXZlbnRzLW5vbmUgaWNvbiIgZGF0YS10ZXN0aWQ9Imljb24tY2xpcGJvYXJkIiBzdHlsZT0id2lkdGg6MThweDtoZWlnaHQ6MThweCIgYXJpYS1oaWRkZW49InRydWUiIGZvY3VzYWJsZT0iZmFsc2UiPjx1c2UgeG1sbnM6eGxpbms9Imh0dHA6Ly93d3cudzMub3JnLzE5OTkveGxpbmsiIHhsaW5rOmhyZWY9IiNpY29uLWNsaXBib2FyZCIgLz48L3N2Zz4="
class="events-none icon" /><span style="position:absolute;border:0;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0, 0, 0, 0);white-space:nowrap;word-wrap:normal">clipboard</span>
